verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a first-party MCP server with concrete hosted endpoints (sandbox and production), OAuth-based Dashboard authentication, and integration steps (e.g. `claude mcp add`), enabling agents to search docs and manage payment operations (query status, refunds, voids, payment links). This is independently corroborated by a live probe showing the production MCP endpoint returning a proper auth-gated JSON-RPC response per the MCP spec. Missing for 10: broader independent/community hands-on usage reports beyond the vendor docs and single probe.
